items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: We're all up in the 80s except Newt, we've got a tenor player that's been in the last two months.

ctx.x: Well at least you're working regularly. So few musicians are, especially the old timers. You think, well probably you and Rudy Powell, Floyd Casey, they play a lot of good old-time jazz too. Anybody want to hear it?

We're all up in the 80s except Newt, we've got a tenor player that's been in the last two months. I don't think he's 30 yet. But I think everybody else there is in the 50s. Is that right? I think Rudy was, the bass player, just hit 50 lately, between Rudy and me, but they're both in the 50s. So we said, you know, come down here, it's the 50, you can't wait. But the first we had on tenor that he's under 29, very good music, he's steady and hard. He wants to get out of there, huh? Well I guess we all do. But it's…
Well the guy at the Metropole seems to do pretty well I guess.
